Scenario: Sign in and POST sign out
Preconditions: Active Admin with known password
Steps: Sign in; open Overview; use Sign out
Expected result: Overview opens; sign-out returns to login; revisiting protected pages requires login

Preconditions: Admin has created a new Employee
Steps: Sign in as new Employee; try My tasks; change password
Expected result: Password-change page required before workspace; new password then permits access

Preconditions: Signed-in application Admin
Steps: Employees → Create employee; enter fields; submit
Expected result: Account listed active; first login requires password change

Preconditions: Signed-in Admin; manual.employee exists
Steps: Create another account with same identifier
Expected result: Inline error; valid name retained; password not echoed; no duplicate

Preconditions: Signed-in Admin; fixture Employee exists
Steps: Edit name with blank reset; then edit with new password
Test data: Updated name; strong optional reset password
Expected result: Blank keeps password; reset requires next password change

Preconditions: Manager owns a fixture project
Steps: Admin edits Manager role to Employee and confirms
Expected result: Rejected with reassignment guidance; ownership unchanged

Preconditions: Employee has completed task and recorded time
Steps: Admin confirms deactivation; try Employee login; inspect report
Expected result: Login denied; task/time/contributor history retained; no Activate action

Preconditions: Signed-in active Manager
Steps: Projects → Create project; submit equal start/end dates
Expected result: Project created and owned by actor; empty project included in list

Preconditions: Signed-in Admin; two active Managers
Steps: Create project with second Manager
Expected result: Project belongs to chosen Manager; first Manager cannot see it

Preconditions: Manager can edit fixture project
Steps: Edit with end date before start date
Expected result: Inline error; entered name/description retained; saved dates unchanged

Preconditions: Manager owns empty fixture project; active Employee exists
Steps: Team → Add employee; select Employee; submit

Steps: Tasks → Create task; select member; submit

Steps: Edit title/description and choose second member
Expected result: Project fixed; details/assignment update; old contributor time stays attributed

Steps: Submit tomorrow using API or bypass native date bound

Preconditions: Two Employees in one project; one has private time note
Steps: Other Employee views team task detail/Tasks; filter My tasks
